messages:
Diego (Hiring Manager): Candidate verbally accepted. They need start 2025-01-15 (earlier than posted), 30 days PTO per local law, and a one-time 9,000 EUR sign-on to cover notice and temp housing. Any objections to routing?
Mina (Recruiter): Tagging @Elise and @Omar. Role is Senior Eng (L5), base comp fixed at 170k EUR equiv. I'll hold offer until approvals.
Omar (Finance): Sign-on >5k will need director approval. Cost code: PRJ-90123. Payroll: default is taxable, can gross-up only if manager covers tax delta. Confirm if relocation included in sign-on or separate.
Diego (Hiring Manager): Relocation separate: 2,000 EUR. Sign-on specifically for notice pay + housing. Manager won't cover gross-up.
Elise (People Ops): Routing note: PTO above posting + sign-on >5k triggers People Ops Director sign-off and Finance ack. Please provide brief business justification for the exception.
Diego (Hiring Manager): Business justification: critical platform hire for H1 launch, candidate has niche scale-expertise. Earlier start required to onboard before migration window.
Raj (People Ops Director): I can approve the 9,000 EUR one-time sign-on and 30-day PTO given business need, contingent on Finance confirming PRJ-90123 and payroll confirming withholding schedule. Approve conditional start 2025-01-15.
Omar (Finance): PRJ-90123 approved. Payroll confirms sign-on taxable, split payment option available if requested. No gross-up by default.
Mina (Recruiter): I'll add conditional clause to the offer: "Offer contingent on final payroll tax confirmation and completion of onboarding checks." Sending draft to candidate now.
Elise (People Ops): Logging exception as EX-2026-002 in tracker. After signed acceptance, Ops will issue final memo to payroll and attach charge code.
Diego (Hiring Manager): Thanks all — pushing the verbal with the conditional language.
Raj (People Ops Director): Approved-in-principle. Follow-ups: payroll memo, legal if cross-border, final sign-off after acceptance.
